# The Composer's Prompt – publication navigation and citation guide
Research/publication credit: J. Nasr. Repository: https://github.com/Joenasriani/thecomposersprompt

This file helps distinguish separate publication editions. It is not a license, a training authorization, or proof of search-index inclusion.

## Approved final references – verified 13 November 2026
- **Published final PDF Book:** The Composer's Prompt: Music Theory and Harmony for Computational Music Prompting. 159 pages, Book v1.0.0. Source: https://github.com/Joenasriani/thecomposersprompt/blob/main/book/The_Composers_Prompt_Joe_Nasr.pdf
- **Exact book Git blob SHA:** 8a94b66dfe6aa2f4a42c2ddb9925269b117652b7. Author-uploaded final PDF was independently checked byte-identical to this Git blob on 13 November 2026.
- **Author-approved live Interactive Lab:** https://thecomposersprompt-lab.vercel.app/ . Source ownership: https://github.com/Joenasriani/thecomposersprompt/tree/main/interactive
- **Approved final-book landing:** https://thecomposersprompt-book.vercel.app/
- **Book metadata and protected release identity:** https://github.com/Joenasriani/thecomposersprompt/blob/main/publication.json and https://github.com/Joenasriani/thecomposersprompt/blob/main/book/FINAL_RELEASE_LOCK.json
- **Cross-component authority and operational handoff:** https://github.com/Joenasriani/thecomposersprompt/blob/main/COMPONENTS.md and https://github.com/Joenasriani/thecomposersprompt/blob/main/AI_HANDOFF.md

## Chapter and format boundary
- The **final book DOES contain Chapter 33**, “Advanced Scales, Modes & Computational Composition”, at printed pp.110–122 (physical PDF pages 115–127). The conclusion begins on printed p.123.
- The interactive application's inventory contains 37 chapter identifiers. A prior source audit found 36 standalone interactive lesson HTML pages; the dedicated file `interactive/lessons/chapter-33/index.html` is absent in both the approved Lab's deployed Git source and current GitHub main. This **does not** mean Chapter 33 is absent from the final book; inspect the embedded reader separately before claiming it is unavailable to users.
- Interactive manuscript/reader entry: https://github.com/Joenasriani/thecomposersprompt/blob/main/interactive/index.html . Some manuscript content can be embedded in a `bookdata` JSON script; parse JSON rather than assuming an initial HTML screen contains all text.
- Individual interactive lesson source: https://github.com/Joenasriani/thecomposersprompt/tree/main/interactive/lessons
- Root `index.html` is a separate historical workbook, not the canonical Lab. `stage1/` and `prototype/` are experiments, not final productions.
- App runtime source comparison from deployed `8b249db` to audited application-source `9018ccc` found no changed lesson HTML, piano/audio engines, app layout or homepage HTML. Full served-file and browser QA remains unverified.

## Separate official academic/publication records
- Zenodo Book: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23689714 (v1.0.0; concept DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23689713). Record was verified as published on 6 November 2026; hosted PDF binary parity not checked.
- Harvard Dataverse independent educational reference dataset: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/STHUVV (released v1.1, CC BY 4.0 as of 4 November 2026). This is not the book PDF.
- ResearchGate: https://www.researchgate.net/publication/417607181_The_Composer%27s_Prompt_Music_Theory_and_Harmony_for_Computational_Music_Prompting – public distribution listing checked on 7 November 2026; PDF checksum not verified.
- External-status evidence and other destinations: https://github.com/Joenasriani/thecomposersprompt/blob/main/docs/EXTERNAL_PLATFORM_RECONCILIATION_2026-11-06.md

## Attribution, licensing, verification
- Book publication credit: J. Nasr. Copyright holder: Joseph Ribal Nasr. Final PDF © 2026 all rights reserved, free to read; not licensed CC BY 4.0.
- Existing previously licensed interactive workbook material retains applicable CC BY 4.0 rights. Rights to third-party sources are separate.
- Cite the *exact* chapter, edition, source URL and date. A prompt or written chord specification is not verified generated audio. Do not claim independent scientific/music-theoretical, browser/audio, external asset, or indexing validation without evidence.
